Our History

The law firm of Antonio Circosta, Attorney at Law, was established to provide high-level legal assistance that combines local roots with an international perspective.

Founded by Antonio Circosta, the Firm has progressively expanded its expertise, becoming a point of reference in international law, corporate law and regulatory compliance.

Over the years we have built a network of professional relationships in Europe, the Middle East, Asia, Africa and the Americas, which enables us to provide legal advice and strategic support in many countries.

Our Values

Our work is founded on principles that guide every professional decision:

  • Expertise: continuous professional development and specialisation in complex areas of law.
  • Reliability: transparency, integrity and commitment to our obligations.
  • Ethics: protection of fundamental rights and social responsibility.
  • International vision: the ability to operate in multicultural settings and across different legal systems.

Our Approach

Trust and confidentiality: the foundation of every professional relationship.

We handle every engagement with a multidisciplinary method that combines legal rigour, attention to the client's needs and an understanding of geopolitical and economic dynamics.

This approach allows us to support companies in corporate governance, risk management and regulatory compliance, as well as to provide defence and advice in civil, criminal and administrative matters.
